title: What Is Crypto Staking? How Locking Coins Can Earn Rewards (And the Risks)
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. Staking means locking coins to help a proof of stake network run, and rewards are not guaranteed. Sources: Investopedia, Coinbase Learn. AI-generated voice. Educational only. Not financial advice.

scenes.head: LOCK COINS, GET PAID?
scenes.narration: Some crypto lets you lock your coins to help run a network, and receive rewards. This is called staking.

scenes.head: WHAT IS STAKING?
scenes.narration: On proof of stake blockchains, people lock coins to help check transactions. In return, the network may pay rewards.

scenes.head: WHERE REWARDS COME FROM
scenes.narration: Rewards usually come from newly created coins and transaction fees. The rate can change over time.

scenes.head: THE RISKS
scenes.narration: But the coin price can still fall, coins may be locked for a while, and some networks penalize bad behavior.

scenes.head: THE PLATFORM RISK
scenes.sub: A PLATFORM CAN FAIL OR FREEZE
scenes.narration: If you stake through a company, you rely on it. If the platform fails or freezes withdrawals, your coins can be stuck.

scenes.head: BEFORE YOU LEARN MORE
scenes.narration: Rewards are never guaranteed, so read the lock up rules and understand the risks first. This is education, not advice.
